profile_unit.definition: a profile is the canonical minimal transitive Product closure required by one or more workload cells
profile_unit.identity: canonical closure digest; the readable alias is presentation only

routable_rule: a profile is routable only when all five readiness states hold; every false state must carry a structured unresolved reason

hot_limit.scope: per Catalog-bound Gateway instance HOT limit

drains_previous_profile_before_stop: no ACTIVE root still served by the current Gateway
isolation: a new Gateway process, so no previous in-process HOT, compiled Catalog or View cache survives
persisted semantic replay is bound by Catalog, profile and Publication binding digests

matched_pair_rule.scope: every arm and repetition of one workload cell
matched_pair_rule.on_mismatch: the whole cell is invalid; the failing evidence is retained and no single arm is deleted
